meta.title: Hybrid — Markdown Editor for Mac | Write with AI, publish as a team
meta.description: Hybrid is the Markdown editor for Mac that remembers who wrote what — you, an AI, or a named source. Real-time collaboration, sharing, and one-click online publishing for PR, marketing, agencies, newsrooms, and journalists.
meta.keywords: Markdown editor, Mac, macOS, AI, artificial intelligence, collaboration, sharing, PR, marketing, public relations, agency, newsroom, journalism, online publishing, provenance

hero.h1: The Markdown editor that knows who wrote what.
hero.sub: Hybrid keeps track of where every passage comes from: written by you, generated by an AI, quoted from a source, or contributed by a colleague. Built for people who publish — in PR, marketing, agencies, and newsrooms.
hero.ios: Hybrid is coming to iPhone and iPad.
hero.shotAlt: The Hybrid editor on macOS with provenance labels: AI-generated text underlined in purple, a source quote labelled in green, and the contribution meter in the sidebar
hero.badgeAlt: Download on the Mac App Store

prov.h2: Who wrote what? Your document knows.
prov.p: Every passage carries its origin — and keeps it through saving, sharing, and co-editing. The record travels inside a plain .md file that any other editor can open; the labels float above your text and never end up in an export.
prov.demoAria: Example of a document with provenance labels: your own text, an AI-marked passage, and a quote labelled with its source
prov.demoYou: This paragraph was typed by you — everything you write automatically counts as yours.
prov.demoAi: This passage came from an AI and is marked, so the machine's share of the text stays visible.
prov.demoSource: This quote comes from an external source and carries its name as a small label.
prov.promise: The central promise: what someone contributed stays attributed to them — even if access is revoked later. Provenance is a record of who wrote, not of who is currently allowed to.

rows.h3: Compare two AI answers side by side
rows.p: The same question went to two AI tools, and the answers look alike at first glance. Hybrid highlights exactly where they differ and counts the differences. Tag each answer with the tool's name as its source, and even after merging you still know which sentence came from which.
rows.alt: Two AI answers to the same question side by side in Hybrid, differences highlighted in color

rows.p: Invite people by link, from Contacts, by Mail or Messages — the document itself stays exclusively in your iCloud. Invitees write along live: every passage carries its author's name and color, and while someone types, their name appears with pulsing dots. Invitees cannot export the document or save it as a file of their own — it belongs to the owner.
rows.alt: Collaboration mode in Hybrid with two authors, each passage labelled with its author's name and color

rows.h3: A live preview, exactly as published
rows.p: Headings, lists, real tables, and embedded images rendered the way your readers will see them. The preview follows your typing live — in its own window or as a split view right next to the editor; ideal for checking a text before it goes into the CMS.
rows.alt: Hybrid's rendered Markdown preview with headings, a table, and an embedded image

cards.p: Copies your document as formatted HTML with embedded images — ready to paste into WordPress and other CMS. Images appear exactly where they belong, not as broken links.
Send your text to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or an app of your choice with one click. Mark AI passages, and read each contributor's share in the sidebar.
Documents are pure .md files any editor can open. Everything Hybrid knows on top — provenance, versions, authors — travels in a single invisible comment.

cards.h3: Images and tables by drag & drop
cards.p: Drop a photo into the text: it is resized, converted, and referenced in Markdown. Drop a CSV or Excel file and it becomes a formatted table.
Hybrid snapshots your work as you write; every state can be viewed and restored. The history lives in your iCloud, not in the file — documents you pass on contain no old versions.
Lock the app instantly or automatically after inactivity. Locked means locked: all windows hidden, exports disabled — until Touch ID unlocks.

aud.intro: Wherever text is written by several hands — human and machine — Hybrid keeps the origins straight.

audiences.p: Draft press releases with AI support and keep every quote attributable. When asked what a human wrote, your document has the answer — transparency as a workflow, not an afterthought.
Many writers, one voice. See each contributor's share, compare drafts side by side, and hand polished HTML to any CMS — the whole content workflow on your Mac.
Separate your own words from sources and AI suggestions. Named sources stay attached to every paragraph — through edits, versions, and shared editing.
Reports co-written with AI need an audit trail. Hybrid records who — or what — wrote every passage, and the Touch ID lock keeps confidential drafts closed.
Compare model outputs side by side, measure the AI share of a document, and keep prompts and results as clean Markdown — readable in any tool.
From Markdown to CMS in one click: formatted HTML with images embedded exactly where they belong. Plus PDF, Word, and clean Markdown export.

ios.h2: Coming soon to iPhone and iPad
ios.p: Hybrid is coming to iOS. The same documents, the same provenance — in your pocket. Until then, your files are plain Markdown in iCloud Drive, readable on every device.

langSection.p: Hybrid is available in nine languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese — and so is this site.

cta.h2: Write with AI. Publish with confidence.
cta.p: Hybrid for Mac — the Markdown editor for people, AI, and everything you publish.

footer.tagline: Hybrid is a Markdown editor for macOS built for collaboration between people and AI — for PR, marketing, public relations, agencies, newsrooms, journalism, consulting, and online publishing. Write, share, compare, and publish from your Mac.
footer.requirements: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later · Apple Silicon & Intel

pro.intro: After installation, Hybrid is free and fully usable for 7 days. After that, the Hybrid Pro subscription unlocks all features — the Mac App Store shows the price.

points.p: The full feature set from the first launch — no account, no payment details.
The subscription runs through the App Store and can be cancelled there at any time. Without it, Hybrid remains a reader: opening, reading, searching, and the preview stay free.
Anyone invited to a collaboration writes along without a subscription of their own — only the document's owner needs one.
